name: classic-standard
_comment: Canonical STANDARD Classic cycle for the trace harness (spec A deliverable 4): toggle at 0, one full healthy cycle -- dig-probe registers and fills (capacity keyframed up), go_water reaches the Pan cue inside the first budget, do_shake drains to empty within SHAKE_HOLD_MS with the momentum W held (no Deposit cue -> W rides the whole drain), POST_SHAKE_SETTLE, then a second dig leg fills again; the Pan cue is gone by then so the final water legs time out until the scheduled quit. Modeled on the Studio repo's engine/scenarios/classic-run.json.
_screen_comment: The benign 1x1 rect flips the sim's capacity paint into whole-box mode (per-column detail is only for the legacy goldens' small boxes); without it the capacity_full region straddles the strip edge and reads a diluted mean that is never yellow, so FULL is unreachable in full-frame grabs.
